title: Marketing Loops With Claude and Codex: Automate Your Game Marketing
author: bingewavecinema
selftext: Making short tutorial video for game devs who hate marketing and work to hard at marketing. One use case withe Claude is it can do a lot of automation for your game while you sleep. When you can come this with asset production and social media, you can create a content machine using your game's assets and Claude.

replies.author: DrElectro
replies.body: So you just have to spam thousands of potential customers to get a lead or two? Is that what you are saying?

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body:
Yes, why think things like CPM are cost per milli? Milli = thousands. Think about your game games conversion from wishlist. 

If you price your game at $5, and your wishlist conversion rate is 10%, you need to sell 2k wishlist, so you need 20k wishlist.

If you wanted to make $1 million, you would need about 2,000,000 wishlit.

If ran a Reddit ad CTR of 2%, you would need at least **100 million ad impressions** to get that many wishlist.

These numbers are not exact because there are other variables, but everything with making money with marketing and sale is about scaling to a lot of people.
